summary: Find and replay shortest safety counterexamples in small finite workflow models.
requires: Local model input and an optional new report path
inputs: A finite JSON model with an initial state, transitions, and invariants
Optional search budgets; an existing report for replay
outputs: JSON verdict, model digest, budgets, and exploration statistics
A replayable shortest counterexample trace when found

enforced: CLI model input at most 128 KiB; report input/output at most 1 MiB
At most 12 variables, 32 values per domain, 64 transitions, and 16 invariants
Default search: 20000 states, 200000 transition checks, depth 64, 5 seconds
Hard search ceilings: 50000 states, 500000 transition checks, depth 128, 10 seconds
Time checked between search steps; capped searches report inconclusive
Existing output paths are not overwritten
operator: Preserve the requested property and expose modeling assumptions
Use only authorized local inputs and outputs
Treat the result as a claim about the finite model, not its real-world implementation

stop_when: A counterexample is found or reachable states are exhausted
The model or witness is invalid; do not silently alter it to get a passing result
